_comment: Android App Links verification for https://jag-spoor.co.za/r/<CODE>. Replace the two sha256_cert_fingerprints placeholders with the real values from Google Play Console -> Release -> Setup -> App integrity (App signing key certificate = Play App Signing SHA-256; upload/release keystore SHA-256). Until real fingerprints are present Android cannot verify the App Link and the jagspoor:// scheme fallback is used.
